headline_marked: Sabbir Al Hasan: [[Ready to return to Bangladesh]] if security is guaranteed
headline: Sabbir Al Hasan: Ready to return to Bangladesh if security is guaranteed
summary: The cricketer wants to face legal charges and play his farewell series, but the government says there is no 'normal' way for his return.
details: Cricketer Shakib Al Hasan told Reuters that he is ready to return to Bangladesh, provided the government guarantees his security. He expressed willingness to legally face all cases against him, including murder charges, and play his final series.
However, State Minister for Youth and Sports Aminul Haque stated that due to Shakib's political positions, there is no longer any opportunity for him to return through a 'normal process.'
The Minister noted that while the government was previously flexible, that window has closed. He emphasized that Shakib must return through legal channels and surrender to the court.
Shakib, a former Member of Parliament for the Awami League, has been living in New York with his family since the fall of Sheikh Hasina's government in July.

Speaking from Sri Lanka, Shakib claimed he has committed no crime and is ready to do whatever is necessary, including facing the courts. He also mentioned a desire to return alongside Sheikh Hasina if a direct return is not possible.
Shakib also expressed interest in speaking with Tarique Rahman. However, a spokesperson for Tarique Rahman described Shakib as a member of a 'fallen, defeated, and fugitive fascist government.'

The Press Secretary to the Prime Minister, Abu Abdullah M Saleh, stated that the current government has nothing to do with creating space for Shakib in the hearts of the people. He reiterated that Shakib is an accused person in the eyes of the law and must surrender to the Bangladeshi courts.
caption:
Shakib Al Hasan wants to return to Bangladesh, but the government says there is no 'normal' way back.

Cricketer Shakib Al Hasan told Reuters that he is ready to return to Bangladesh, provided the government guarantees his security. He expressed willingness to legally face all cases against him, including murder charges, and play his final series.

However, State Minister for Youth and Sports Aminul Haque stated that due to Shakib's political positions, there is no longer any opportunity for him to return through a 'normal process.'

The Minister noted that while the government was previously flexible, that window has closed. He emphasized that Shakib must return through legal channels and surrender to the court.

Shakib, a former Member of Parliament for the Awami League, has been living in New York with his family since the fall of Sheikh Hasina's government in July.

Speaking from Sri Lanka, Shakib claimed he has committed no crime and is ready to do whatever is necessary, including facing the courts. He also mentioned a desire to return alongside Sheikh Hasina if a direct return is not possible.

Shakib also expressed interest in speaking with Tarique Rahman. However, a spokesperson for Tarique Rahman described Shakib as a member of a 'fallen, defeated, and fugitive fascist government.'

The Press Secretary to the Prime Minister, Abu Abdullah M Saleh, stated that the current government has nothing to do with creating space for Shakib in the hearts of the people. He reiterated that Shakib is an accused person in the eyes of the law and must surrender to the Bangladeshi courts.

headline_marked: Gold prices jump ৳4,374 per bhori; [[22k gold now ৳234,038]]
headline: Gold prices jump ৳4,374 per bhori; 22k gold now ৳234,038
summary: The Bangladesh Jewellers Association (BAJUS) has increased gold prices for the second day in a row, marking the 100th price adjustment of the year.
details: The price of 22-carat gold has been set at ৳234,038 per bhori, following an increase of ৳4,374. The new rates were announced by the Bangladesh Jewellers Association (BAJUS) on Saturday morning and became effective from 10 AM.
caption:
Gold prices jump again! 22k gold now costs ৳234,038 per bhori after a ৳4,374 hike.

The price of 22-carat gold has been set at ৳234,038 per bhori, following an increase of ৳4,374. The new rates were announced by the Bangladesh Jewellers Association (BAJUS) on Saturday morning and became effective from 10 AM.
